title: Bombo y Ponche
comment: Salsa in the son montuno tradition, C minor, 184 BPM, on a 2-3 son clave (odd bars are the 2-side). Intro on Abmaj7 | G7, a flute head through a minor circle of fifths, a montuno on Cm Fm | G7 Fm where coro and sonero trade and each cycle adds a layer, a mambo of trombone, trumpet, and sax riffs entering one at a time, and a cierre that stops on the last clave stroke.
